questions.q: In 470 582, which digit is in the thousands place?
questions.x: 470 582 = 4 hundred thousands, 7 ten thousands, 0 thousands, 5 hundreds, 8 tens, 2 ones.

questions.q: Round 64 950 to the nearest thousand.
questions.x: The hundreds digit is 9 (5 or more), so round up: 64 950 → 65 000.

questions.q: Find the value of 8 + 12 ÷ 4 × 2.
questions.x: Divide and multiply from left to right before adding: 12 ÷ 4 = 3, 3 × 2 = 6, then 8 + 6 = 14.

questions.q: What is the smallest number that is a multiple of both 6 and 8?
questions.x: Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24… The first one that is also a multiple of 6 is 24.

questions.q: Find the value of 3/4 − 1/6.
questions.x: Use twelfths: 9/12 − 2/12 = 7/12.

questions.q: What is 2/5 of 45?
Find the value of 3 ÷ 1/4.
questions.x: Dividing by 1/4 is the same as multiplying by 4: 3 × 4 = 12. There are 12 quarters in 3.

questions.q: Which fraction is the largest?
Find the value of 0.4 × 0.3.
questions.x: 4 × 3 = 12, and there are two decimal places in total, so 0.12.

questions.q: Find the value of 3.6 ÷ 0.06.
questions.x: Multiply both by 100: 360 ÷ 6 = 60.

questions.q: Express 2 7/20 as a decimal.
What is 15% of 80?
questions.x: 10% of 80 is 8 and 5% is 4, so 15% is 12.

questions.q: A bag costs $60 after a 25% discount. What was its original price?
questions.x: $60 is 75% of the original price. 25% is $20, so 100% is $80.

questions.q: A 9% tax is added to a $200 item. What is the total price?
questions.x: 9% of $200 is $18, so the total is $218.

questions.q: The number of pupils in a club rose from 40 to 50. What is the percentage increase?
questions.x: The increase of 10 is compared with the original 40: 10/40 = 1/4 = 25%.

questions.q: Ali and Ben share $90 in the ratio 2 : 3. How much does Ben get?
questions.x: There are 5 units in total, so 1 unit = $18. Ben gets 3 units = $54.

questions.q: The ratio of boys to girls in a hall is 3 : 5. There are 30 girls. How many boys are there?
questions.x: 5 units = 30, so 1 unit = 6 and the boys are 3 units = 18.

questions.q: Express 12 : 18 : 30 in its simplest form.
questions.x: Divide each term by the highest common factor, 6: 2 : 3 : 5.

questions.q: Find the value of 3y − 5 when y = 4.
Simplify 5a + 3 − 2a + 4.
questions.x: Group like terms: 5a − 2a = 3a and 3 + 4 = 7.

questions.q: Pens cost $k each. Mary buys 6 pens and pays with a $20 note. How much change does she get, in dollars?
questions.x: The 6 pens cost 6k dollars, so the change is 20 − 6k.

questions.q: Find the area of the figure shown. All angles are right angles.
questions.x: The full rectangle is 10 × 6 = 60 cm². The cut-out corner is 4 × 3 = 12 cm². 60 − 12 = 48 cm².

questions.q: A square has a perimeter of 36 cm. What is its area?
questions.x: Each side is 36 ÷ 4 = 9 cm, so the area is 9 × 9 = 81 cm².

questions.q: Find the area of the semicircle shown. Take π = 22/7.
questions.x: A full circle of radius 7 cm has area 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². Half of it is 77 cm².

questions.q: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 5 cm. What is its area?
questions.x: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 5 = 30 cm².

questions.q: What is the volume of the cuboid shown?
questions.x: Volume = 5 × 4 × 3 = 60 cm³. (94 cm² is its surface area, a common slip.)

questions.q: A tank measures 50 cm by 40 cm by 30 cm. It is filled with water to 3/4 of its height. How much water is in the tank? (1 ℓ = 1000 cm³)
questions.x: The water is 3/4 × 30 = 22.5 cm deep. Volume = 50 × 40 × 22.5 = 45 000 cm³ = 45 ℓ.

questions.q: A cube has a volume of 64 cm³. What is the length of one edge?
questions.x: 4 × 4 × 4 = 64, so each edge is 4 cm.

questions.q: Find angle x in the figure. The three angles lie on a straight line.
questions.x: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°: x = 180° − 48° − 67° = 65°.

questions.q: The triangle shown is isosceles. Find angle y.
questions.x: The base angles are equal and the three angles add up to 180°: y = (180° − 40°) ÷ 2 = 70°.

questions.q: One angle of a parallelogram is 65°. What is the size of an angle next to it?
questions.x: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram add up to 180°: 180° − 65° = 115°.

questions.q: Which shape always has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
questions.x: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides. The other three have two pairs.

questions.q: A car travels 150 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.x: Speed = distance ÷ time = 150 ÷ 2.5 = 60 km/h.

questions.q: Siti walks at 5 km/h for 1 hour 12 minutes. How far does she walk?
questions.x: 1 h 12 min = 1.2 h (12 min = 0.2 h). Distance = 5 × 1.2 = 6 km.

questions.q: Express 72 km/h in metres per second.
The pie chart shows the favourite sports of 120 pupils. How many pupils chose swimming?
questions.x: Swimming is a right angle, 90° of 360°, which is 1/4 of the circle. 1/4 of 120 = 30.

questions.x: Tuesday 7, Wednesday 3: 7 − 3 = 4.

questions.q: Find the average of 12, 15, 18 and 23.
questions.x: Total = 68, and 68 ÷ 4 = 17.

questions.q: The average of 4 numbers is 25. When a fifth number is added, the average becomes 28. What is the fifth number?
questions.x: The total goes from 4 × 25 = 100 to 5 × 28 = 140, so the fifth number is 40.

questions.q: Using the bar graph, find the average number of books read per day.
questions.x: Total = 4 + 7 + 3 + 6 = 20 books over 4 days, so the average is 5.
